out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Poison/Toxic Material, Conditions of Use
violations.observation: Pesticides labeled for residential use were observed in the facility and are being applied by the operator to control pests. EHS observed Raid in kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Remove residential use pesticides from the facility. When necessary for pest control, chemical pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT HOUSE HOLD PREST CONTROL METHODS ARE NOT ALLOWED IN FACILITY AND MUST ONLY BE APPLIED BY A CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR. PIC THREW AWAY RAID.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: Observed multiple holes in ceiling and walls above dry stock area.
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. PIC UNDERSTANDS THAT THE HOLES IN THE CEILING NEED TO BE REPAIRED BY TIME OF NEXT ROUTINE INSPECTION.
